title: Localy Optimized
description: A lightweight Fabric modpack featuring performance optimizations for low-end hardware, alongside useful client-side utility tools for builders.
body:
**Localy Optimized is a Fabric-based modpack designed specifically for builders, bundling performance-focused client-side mods to maintain frame rate stability during builds alongside a selection of lightweight utility tools.**

**Tested on low-end hardware to ensure stable performance.**

>💡 **Pro-Tip**: Join multiplayer servers with this pack to get the absolute highest FPS and smoothest gameplay.

# ⚙️ Configuration Recommendations
The following in-game settings are suggested to reduce hardware strain:

* **Framerate Limit**: 60 FPS (or monitor refresh rate).
* **VSync**: Off.
* **Graphics Quality**: Fast.
* **Leaves**: Fast
* **Clouds**: Fast or Off
* **Simulation Distance**: 4-5 Chunks.
* **Render Distance**: 6-8 Chunks.

![In-game screenshot of a stable 59 FPS while facing player builds.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6f1fe79285c8b7399090abc6e3fba6aca47d94c0.png)

# 🛠️ Included Mod Functionality

### Performance
* **Sodium**: Replaces the vanilla rendering engine with an optimized pipeline to reduce rendering overhead.
* **Lithium**: Provides general-purpose optimizations for game physics and entity AI.
* **ImmediatelyFast**: Optimizes the rendering of UI elements and text.
* **FerriteCore**: Reduces the RAM footprint of the game.
* **ModernFix**: Optimizes launch times and asset caching.

### Utility
* **Mouse Wheelie**: Adds full inventory management and also adds **Mouse Tweaks** dragging mechanics, plus build-in middle-click sorting shortcut.
* **Shulker Box Tooltip**: Displays shulker box contents when hovering over the item.
* **Simple HUD Enhanced**: Displays status information on the HUD.
* **WI Freecam**: Provides a camera detachment tool for viewing builds.
* **Disable Fog (No Fog)**: Removes the fog rendering layer.
